general.title: General Settings
general.subtitle: Appearance & Language
general.languageHint: Choose the display language. It applies immediately and is saved automatically.
general.themeHint: Choose the color scheme. It applies immediately and is saved automatically.
general.fontHint: Only free-for-commercial-use fonts. If a font is not installed, grab it from the official link and restart. You can also import your own ttf/otf/woff/woff2.
general.previewText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 0123456789. Tide over stone steps, lamps lit one by one.
general.systemHint: Closing minimizes to tray by default (right-click the tray icon to quit); auto-launch applies immediately.
general.minimizeToTrayHint: Hide to tray instead of quitting when the window closes
general.autoLaunchHint: Start Hongyue Creation automatically after login
general.crashReportingHint: Crash dumps are uploaded to the configured endpoint after restart (takes effect on restart)
general.crashReportingUnconfigured: No endpoint configured; crash dumps are kept locally only
general.proxyHint: Blank means direct. Once set, chat requests and model-list fetches go through it.
general.proxyBadUrl: Invalid address: needs an http/https/socks5 scheme plus hostname
general.proxyWebNote: Web preview has no desktop proxy support; the address only applies in the desktop app.
general.proxyLocalNote: Local services (e.g. Ollama on localhost) bypass the proxy and connect directly.
general.shortcutsHint: Click an action, then press a combo to record. Conflicting combos are rejected.

skills.title: Writing skills
skills.hint: Skills are data, not code: import a SKILL.md with frontmatter and it is injected when its trigger matches.

footer.persistNote: Local data persistence is enabled; settings are saved automatically to the app data directory on this machine.
footer.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Closing now will discard them. Continue?

guide.title: Model Provider Setup Guide
guide.subtitle: Quickly find the API signup URL, endpoint and correct configuration for mainstream providers. Official channels only need a Key.
guide.step1Desc: Click "Quick Add" on a card and the protocol, endpoint and recommended model are preset automatically.
guide.step2Desc: Official channels only need an API Key; for custom channels also fill in the endpoint and model name.
guide.step3Desc: Click "Test Connection Now" to confirm the configuration works and can communicate.

models.apiKeyHint: After entering an API Key, you can refresh to fetch the available model list
models.temperatureHint: Controls output randomness; higher values are more creative
models.maxTokensPlaceholder: Decided by the model by default
models.maxTokensHint: Limits the maximum output length; leave blank to use the model default
models.priceHint: Used for cost estimation. Leave blank to skip billing.
models.systemPromptPlaceholder: System-level instructions guiding the model's behavior...
models.systemPromptHint: System-level instructions that guide the model's basic behavior
models.streamingHint: When enabled, AI output is shown in real time for a better experience
models.emptyFilter: No matching provider, try another keyword
models.emptyAll: No provider yet, add one first
models.gatewayHint: Aggregator gateway: one Key for many models. Stop the URL at /v1 (no /chat/completions); use the gateway model ID, refresh to pull the list.

diag.auth: Likely a wrong/expired Key: copy it again, watch for whitespace.
diag.quota: Billing/quota issue: check balance and plan in the console.
diag.rateLimit: Rate limited: retry later or lower concurrency.
diag.network: Network unreachable: check proxy/VPN and direct reachability.
diag.config: Wrong endpoint or model: stop the URL at /v1 and pick from the refreshed list.
diag.unknown: Unknown error: try another model, or cross-check with a gateway Key.

models.vaultUnavailable: System keychain unavailable; {{count}} key(s) will be saved in plaintext (works fine, just not encrypted at rest)

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.subtitle: Manage where your project data is stored, with custom paths, migration and automatic backups
storage.integrityFailed: The database may be corrupted: {{result}}. Restore from a backup (backup history below).
storage.integrityUnsupported: The current storage backend does not support integrity checks.
storage.openPathFailed: Failed to open: folder missing or no permission.
storage.useCustomHint: When enabled, data is saved to the directory you choose
storage.electronUnavailable: Electron API unavailable; please use this feature in the Electron app
storage.autoBackupHint: When enabled, the system periodically backs up all data
storage.intervalHint: Choose the auto-backup interval. Each backup overwrites the previous one, keeping only the latest.
storage.manualBackupNote: Manual backup takes effect after you save the configuration
storage.backupFailed: Backup failed. Check disk space and retry.
storage.dbBackupTitle: Database hot backups (VACUUM INTO, includes unflushed WAL data)
storage.dbBackupRestoreConfirm: Overwrite the current database with "{{name}}"? The current database is hot-backed-up first; restart the app after restoring.
storage.dbBackupRestoreDone: Restored. Restart the app to load the restored data.
storage.restoreConfirm: Restoring overwrites all current data with this backup. Continue?
storage.restoreFailed: Restore failed: backup file is corrupted or invalid.
storage.restoreTooNew: This backup is from a newer version and cannot be read. Please upgrade the app first.
storage.policyLine1: • Auto backup checks the interval on every data save
storage.policyLine2: • Backup files are stored in the "backups" folder of the data directory
storage.policyLine3: • Only the latest backup is kept; older backups are cleaned automatically
storage.policyLine4: • Backups include full project data and app state
storage.clearHint: This deletes all project data, settings and backups, and cannot be undone.
storage.clearConfirm: ⚠️ Warning: this deletes ALL data, including projects, settings and backups. Continue?
storage.encryptionHint: Encrypt the database file with SQLCipher-compatible AES-256; the key is kept in the OS keychain. This guards data at rest (lost device, copied backups), not malware running as your user.
storage.encryptionUnavailable: OS keychain is unavailable; encryption cannot be enabled.
storage.encryptionWeakBackend: The keychain is using the weak basic_text backend; consider installing a desktop keychain or using disk encryption.
storage.enableEncryptionConfirm: The database will be encrypted immediately. Export and keep the recovery code offline, or the data is unrecoverable if the keychain is lost. Enable now?
storage.disableEncryptionConfirm: The database will be converted back to plaintext. Disable now?
storage.encryptionEnabledDone: Database encryption enabled. The recovery code was copied to the clipboard—keep it safe offline.
storage.encryptionDisabledDone: Database encryption disabled; the database is plaintext again.
storage.recoveryHint: Use this code to rebuild the key file on a new machine or after keychain loss. Keep it offline. Copied to clipboard.
storage.recoveryCopied: Recovery code copied to the clipboard.
storage.recoveryApplied: Recovery code applied. Restart the app to reopen the database.
storage.customPathDbNote: On desktop the database stays in the default data directory; this custom path only affects backups and the JSON fallback, not the database.
storage.restorePreviewHint: Select the books to restore; others keep their current state. The current database is backed up first.

plugins.title: Plugin Management
plugins.description: Discovered plugins and their runtime state. Disabling is config-level; plugin files are kept.
plugins.empty: No plugins installed. Put plugin folders under the plugins/ directory of the app data path.

mcp.title: External MCP Servers
mcp.hint: Connect external MCP servers (stdio commands). Their tools join the assistant toolbox as mcp.* and go through approval.

profile.title: Profile
profile.hint: minimal disables all AI requests (sessions and tools) immediately; switch back anytime.

trust.title: Trusted signing keys
trust.hint: Paste plugin signing public keys (PEM, separate multiple with a blank line). Plugins shipping plugin.sig must be signed by a listed key or they are rejected; an empty list rejects all signed plugins.

sources.title: Plugin source allowlist
sources.hint: One manifest.source identifier per line. When non-empty, plugins from other sources are rejected; an empty list allows any source but still checks signatures.

plugins.settingsCorrupt: Plugin settings were corrupt and reset to defaults; the original value is backed up at plugin.<id>.settings.corrupt

operationLog.title: Operation log
operationLog.subtitle: Body revisions of the current work, with author (user / ai:<tool>) and trigger cause.

mirror.title: External folder mirror
mirror.subtitle: Export the work as Markdown and project.json into a chosen folder for cloud sync or re-import; never mixed with the live database.
mirror.failed: Operation failed. Check folder permissions and contents.
mirror.desktopOnly: This feature is available on desktop only.

collab.title: Real-time collaboration
collab.subtitle: When on, multiple windows on this machine sync the current work's chapters via BroadcastChannel. The collaborative copy adds no second store beyond the live database; cross-device transport is a separate add-on.
collab.waiting: Waiting for a work to open
collab.serverHint: Leave empty for same-machine windows; set ws:// or wss:// when all peers connect to the same relay for cross-device sync.
